rules.default: One complete original frame with all owned artwork and speech.
rules.pair: Maximum two adjacent consecutive frames with immediate action/dialogue or continuous composition requiring their joint presentation. Page-level scene continuity alone is insufficient.
rules.quality: Substantial partial neighbors or truncated neighboring text fail focused extraction. Incidental gutter traces/shared foreground and decorative credits add no original frames.
rules.fallback: Unresolved frames stay in normal-page mode; future automatic reading pauses for manual reading.
rules.counting: Count selection steps separately from unique original frames. Rejected groups and overlaps add no qualifying coverage.
rules.futureTiming: Start adjustable reading pause after animation settles.
rules.runtimeConstraint: Review labels, pages, hashes, text and comic identities must never become runtime lookup logic.

method.inventory: Visual review of all 24 source images, including 22 story pages and 99 originals; same denominator as historic audit.
method.detectionBaseline: Stored Test119 descriptors from hash-verified replay checkpoint; no fresh full-detector run or detector change.
method.readerReplay: Fresh native-canvas execution of unchanged Reader createPanelOverlay/zoomToPanel, real hit testing and final animation/dim state for all 51 selections.
method.proofDisplay: 560 x 860 native composite using actual Reader final geometry and 0.95 dim opacity. Not browser or phone screenshots.
method.integrity: 13 checkpoint payload hashes and 121 runtime-source hashes verified; 24 source image hashes match the offline inventory.
method.semanticReview: Human-readable visual judgment from source/actual crops; not an automated semantic continuity detector.
method.phoneAcceptance: Pending. Passing extraction audit is not proof of phone readability or automatic playback acceptance.
method.priorCounts: Test119 83/99 artwork-preservation count permitted broader groups; 36/99 here uses stricter focus rules, not a measured runtime loss. Historic Test90 also tolerated neighbor speech fragments that now fail.
